settings_saved: Saved as you change them to {file}
settings_rig_lead: Frequency and mode from rigctld. Nothing about the rig is sent to the server.
settings_rig_off: Off. Frequency and mode are entered by hand.
settings_rig_modes: Logged mode for each rig mode
settings_rig_modes_hint: Used when the rig changes to a mode the logged one does not fit. Choosing a mode on the entry screen updates it.
settings_rig_mode_label: Logged mode when the rig is in {mode}
settings_language_follows: Follows the language of the operating system.
settings_language_reload: The window reloads in the chosen language.
settings_listen_lead: QSOs from WSJT-X and ADIF over UDP are logged at once; the client's own JSON fills the form.
settings_listen_exposed: On {addresses}, other machines on the network can log QSOs and fill the form too. No sender is checked.
settings_tray_switch: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
settings_tray_on: Closing the window keeps it in the tray, logging from other programs. Quit from the tray menu.
